title: Part of a program shut down as 'demonic technology'

tellings.quote: had people actually shut down a piece of a program on the basis that american taxpayer dollars should not be spent on pursuing demonic technology

plain: A physicist, Hal Puthoff, who has worked on government research into unusual phenomena, says that people inside the US government once shut down part of a research program. According to Puthoff, they argued that American taxpayer money should not be spent pursuing what they called demonic technology. He tells it in a debate with a podcast guest, Eric Weinstein, to show that religious belief has shaped how such research is handled.
